hypotheses.justification: `MeanRankUpdate.chartQ coord x` is positive for every `coord` and every `x`, so the membership hypothesis is not needed. By `chartQ_eq_slow` (LocalSignedRequest.lean:1243), `MeanRankUpdate.chartQ coord p = SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ coord (p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)`. The proof term in the theorem also relies on this, since it uses `U.q_mem x.2.1 hx`. In SimilarityCoordinates.lean:135, `coordinateQ a p` is defined as `if hp : 0 < a ∧ a < 1 ∧ 0 < p.1 then Classical.choose (exists_positive_solution ...) else 1`. In the first branch, `Classical.choose_spec` gives `0 < q`, because `exists_positive_solution` states `∃ q, 0 < q ∧ …`. In the junk branch the value is `1 > 0`. There is no other case, so no extra assumption on `coord` or `x` is needed. Proof without `hx`: `unfold MeanRankUpdate.chartQ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.qCoord SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ; split_ifs with h; exacts [(Classical.choose_spec (SimilarityCoordinates.exists_positive_solution h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2 _)).1, one_pos]`. Alternatively, rewrite with `chartQ_eq_slow` first and then case-split in the same way. After deleting `hx`, `U` remains an argument that the proof does not use. That is allowed, because only `hx` is being deleted. `U` cannot be deleted on its own, since `hx` mentions `U.carrier`.
